notes:
- One toolbar instead of two: ☰ menu on the left, Undo (↶) next to the arrows – hover it to see what it will undo – and Settings as a ⚙ icon. Cut, Copy, Paste, Rename and New folder are in the right-click menu and on the usual keys
- Preview | Journal switch moved to the top of the right panel
- Quick access: a + button (this folder or choose a folder), a "Drop here to pin" area while dragging, and drag rows to reorder
- Tags: "+ New tag" (then drag files onto it), right-click a tag to rename or delete it
